newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurance firms Q2 net jumps to PLN 108 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurance firms Q2 net jumps to PLN 108 mln.

text.p: Polish insurance firms' net rose to 108.8 million zlotys in the second quarter of 1996, up from 46.4 million in the same period in 1995, although the number of loss-making firms increased, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
It said 15 firms of the 37 polled, reported net profit, down from last year's 19, while 22 had net losses, up from 17 last year.
Last year GUS polled 36 insurance companies.
It said the insurers' gross premium rose to 38.6 percent to 4.3 billion zlotys.
